a.name: Bear
a.description: Big, cuddly, but don’t steal its snacks!

a.name: Cat
a.description: Self-proclaimed ruler of the game. You serve it now.

a.name: Goat
a.description: Climbs anything, eats everything, fears nothing! This hoofed hooligan is chaos on four legs!

a.name: Cow
a.description: Chill, chunky, and full of charm. This cow loves naps, snacks, and occasional stampedes when nobody’s looking.

a.name: Deer
a.description: Graceful, speedy… scared of literally everything.

a.name: Dog
a.description: Loyal, goofy, and always chasing things he’ll never catch, like his own tail. Your new best buddy!

a.name: Frog
a.description: Bright, bouncy, and possibly poisonous! This little hopper’s got big jumps, loud croaks, and zero chill. Ribbit!

a.name: Jaguar
a.description: Silent, sleek, and faster than your Wi-Fi! This jungle ninja strikes hard, naps harder, and always looks cool doing it

a.name: Rabbit
a.description: Hops around like it drank five energy drinks.

a.name: Beaver
a.description: This overly enthusiastic log-chewer thinks everything is a dam project. Will chew your enemies’ defenses… or your furniture

a.name: Badger
a.description: Nature’s grumpy garden gnome. Digging tunnels, fighting bees, and looking perpetually annoyed since forever.

a.name: Caiman
a.description: A crocodile’s sneaky cousin who lurks like it’s always planning a prank — and maybe it is.

a.name: Capybara
a.description: The chillest creature alive. Basically a furry potato that vibes with everyone. Even caimans

a.name: Crab
a.description: Tiny sideways tank. Pinches first, asks questions never. Sandcastle destroyer by trade.

a.name: Dolphin
a.description: A smiley ocean genius who surfs waves and judges your intelligence. Secretly plotting something.

a.name: Duck
a.description: Quack-powered chaos in a feathery tuxedo. Cute, loud, occasionally terrifying.

a.name: Iguana
a.description: Lounge lizard with a mohawk. Too cool to move fast. Loves sunbathing and salad.

a.name: Moose
a.description: A majestic forest horse with tree-branch antlers and zero understanding of personal space.

a.name: Otter
a.description: Floating fuzzballs who hold hands, crack shellfish, and look like they’re in a soap opera.

a.name: Owl
a.description: Feathered librarian of the woods. Sees all. Knows all. Might judge your grammar.

a.name: Raccoon
a.description: Trash panda extraordinaire. Masked like a bandit, snacks like a king.

a.name: Seagull
a.description: Loud beach hooligan with a hunger for fries and no respect for picnics.

a.name: Shark
a.description: Toothy sea missile. Not evil, just misunderstood and really into cardio.

a.name: Toucan
a.description: Flying rainbow with a fruit slicer for a face. Lives in style, squawks in stereo.

a.name: Bat
a.description: Tiny night goblin with built-in sonar and a flair for the dramatic.

a.name: Axolotl
a.description: Smiling water gremlin that refuses to grow up, literally.

a.name: Squirrel
a.description: Hyperactive tree ninja with acorn hoarding issues.

a.name: Red Fox
a.description: Ginger floof who’s sure a dramatic tail swish can solve literally anything.

a.name: Flamingo
a.description: Standing on one leg because drama is a lifestyle.

a.name: Monkey
a.description: Pocket rocket in a fur coat, buzzing from vine to vine while inventing brand-new jungle sound effects

a.name: Horse
a.description: Mane-whipping wind machine posing for epic photos, then sideways-jumping at imaginary ghosts just for fun

a.name: Zebra
a.description: Stripey horse with commitment issues. Can’t pick black or white, so went with both.

a.name: Giraffe
a.description: Walking skyscraper with spots, sass, and zero neck control.

a.name: Lion
a.description: Savanna’s drama king. Big hair, big roar, bigger ego.
